guards: Do not apply unless independently reviewed, owner-authorised and current state/head unchanged; verify previous controller stopped and no active release.
No permit written or claimed, no fence advanced, no main/Pages change.
Archive full original bytes; no history deletion; older receipts remain reachable in immutable Git history and archive file.
Controller's next claim may omit the archive pointer from active JSON; archive file remains in branch tree. Future rotation must keep all archives discoverable.
A smaller state is a diagnostic hypothesis; HTTP500 cause not proved. Normal controller must record ACCEPTED for exact final PR head before merge.
If API failure persists, stop; do not manually forge permit or reset state.
